$comment: fx test settings (v1 F4, tools/fx-test.mjs). Which overlay page renders each effect in host mode, how the host render is set up, and how frames are sampled. Effect names are the ones in data/effects/guards.json. Pages are rel paths under the overlay root (overlays/...), never absolute.

storm.source: legacy chat-storm fires itself on chat (data/overlays/feed-scopes.json effectPages); effect.fire alone may draw nothing, then fx test reports no-render

charge.source: legacy chat-charge fires itself on chat (data/overlays/feed-scopes.json effectPages); effect.fire alone may draw nothing, then fx test reports no-render

campop.source: legacy cam-pop-frame; not yet rendered by fx test

render.backgroundNote: Black behind the overlay: the darkest backdrop gives the largest luminance swing for a bright flash, so it is the worst case for the general threshold. Real gameplay behind the overlay lowers it.

sample.note: Frames are scaled down (area filter) to this size and analysed as rgb24. Sizes divide by 6 so the one-third windows and one-sixth strides land on whole pixels.
sample.drawnNote: host mode: the share of pixels that must differ from the first frame by more than 24 levels for the effect to count as drawn (same as app/host/tests/host-browser.test.mjs)
